class Cache</old_text><new_text>

class TTLCache:
    def __init__(self, ttl_seconds, clock):
        self.ttl_seconds = ttl_seconds
        self.clock = clock
        self._values = {}

    def set(self, key, value):
        self._values[key] = (value, self.clock())

    def get(self, key):
        item = self._values.get(key)
        if item is None or self.clock() - item[1] >= self.ttl_seconds:
            self._values.pop(key, None)
            return None
        return item[0]

class Cache</new_text></tool>
